name: High-Temperature Valve Setpoint
text: <memo>#NOTES#The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C.

name: Sensor-to-Valve Pipe Distance
text: <memo>#NOTES#The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.

name: Common Low-Temperature Valve
text: <memo>#NOTES#The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low-temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler.
